# ICFM - International Conferences on Flood Management

> A global platform for advancing flood management research, policy, and practice through international conferences, declarations, and collaborative knowledge exchange.

ICFM hosts biennial international conferences and symposiums that bring together flood management experts, researchers, and policymakers from around the world. The organization maintains an extensive archive of conference proceedings, research papers, and policy declarations focused on disaster resilience, climate adaptation, and water resource management.

## Key Topics

- Flood Management
- Disaster Prevention & Resilience
- Climate Change Adaptation
- Water Resources Engineering
- Risk Assessment & Early Warning
- International Collaboration
- ICFM Conferences (ICFM5-ICFM9)
- ISFD Symposiums
- Flood Defense Infrastructure
- Disaster Management Policy
- Environmental Engineering
- Water Engineering

## About ICFM

- [About ICFM](https://icfm.world/About-ICFM): Overview of ICFM organization and its role in international flood management
- [Awards](https://icfm.world/Awards): Lifetime achievement awards for flood management leaders and researchers

## ICFM Conferences & Symposiums

- [ICFM Conferences](https://icfm.world/ICFM-Conferences): Archive of ICFM conferences in Tsukuba, Japan, Leeds and disaster resilience
- [ICFM9 - Photo Wall](https://icfm.world/ICFM-Conferences/ICFM9): ICFM9 conference documentation with photo gallery from Tsukuba, Tokyo
- [ICFM8 - Introduction](https://icfm.world/ICFM-Conferences/ICFM8): ICFM8 conference introduction covering resilience and risk reduction topics
- [ICFM7 - Introduction](https://icfm.world/ICFM-Conferences/ICFM7): ICFM7 conference on flood prediction, climate change, urbanization impacts
- [ICFM6 - Introduction](https://icfm.world/ICFM-Conferences/ICFM6): ICFM6 conference from Kassel, Germany on flood defense and disaster management
- [ICFM5 - Introduction](https://icfm.world/ICFM-Conferences/ICFM5): ICFM5 Tokyo 2011 conference on water resources and disaster management
- [ISFD4 - Introduction](https://icfm.world/ICFM-Conferences/ISFD4): ISFD4 International Symposium on Flood Defence from Toronto 2008
- [ISFD3 - Plenary Sessions](https://icfm.world/ICFM-Conferences/ISFD3): ISFD3 plenary sessions on flood protection and living with floods
- [ISFD2 - Introduction](https://icfm.world/ICFM-Conferences/ISFD2): ISFD2 Second International Symposium on Flood Defence overview
- [ISFD1 - Introduction](https://icfm.world/ICFM-Conferences/ISFD1): ISFD1 inaugural symposium by University of Kassel on flood defence

## Official Declarations & Documents

- [ICFM Declarations](https://icfm.world/ICFM-Conferences/ICFM-DECLARATIONS): Official declarations and documents from ICFM9, ICFM8 conferences

## Research & Knowledge Resources

- [Views - Research Portal](https://icfm.world/Views): Portal for research resources, reports on climate change and water engineering
- [Research Papers](https://icfm.world/Views/Papers): Research papers on flood risk assessment, early warning systems, climate adaptation
- [Reports](https://icfm.world/Views/Reports): Reports on disaster prevention, environmental policy from G20, COP 30
- [Brief Statements](https://icfm.world/Views/Brief-Statements): Brief statements from World Water Forum and international flood management forums

## News & Events

- [News](https://icfm.world/News): Latest flood management news and disaster alerts from Kenya, Ethiopia, Brazil
- [Webinars](https://icfm.world/Webinars): Webinars on flood forecasting, climate resilience across Asia, Texas, Spain
